node.statement: For Z=(Z_ij) in M_2(M_n tensor S_P), put D=diag(Z_11,Z_12,Z_21,Z_22), A_0=[[1,1,0,0],[0,0,1,1]], and B_0=[[1,0],[0,1],[1,0],[0,1]]. Then Z=(A_0 tensor I_n)D(B_0 tensor I_n), ||A_0||=||B_0||=sqrt(2), and iterated ax_R2 gives ||D||=max_ij||Z_ij||. Thus ax_R1 gives ||Z||<=2 max_ij||Z_ij||. Also Z_ij=(e_i^* tensor I_n)Z(e_j tensor I_n), so ax_R1 gives ||Z_ij||<=||Z||.
